threads.body: Longest Wait to become Rank 1 after becoming rank 2 Sir Andrew Baron Murray - 7 years (2009-2016) Boris Becker - almost 4.5 years (1986-1991) Stefan Edberg - 3.5 years (1987-1990) Rafael Nadal - 3 years (2005-2008) Wilander - almost 2.5 years (86-88) Borg - almost 2.5 years (75-77) *** Alexander Zverev is on a 4 year wait since he became rank 2 in 2022, if he becomes rank 1 in 2026 then he will join this list ***

threads.title: Do You Want to be truly Happy or truly Free?
threads.body: Truly happy means being content and at peace with your life, even when life isn’t perfect. Truly free means having the courage and ability to live according to your own values without being controlled by fear, expectations, or other people’s approval. In short, happiness is peace with your life; freedom is ownership of your life. Given the above, I will always choose to be truly free. How about you?

threads.title: Who would have won more majors if they maxmized their talent: Becker or Agassi?
threads.body: Agassi won 8 majors and Becker 6. Given how young Becker was when he won his first, he probably could have hit double digits if he was focused. Agassi had a great late career but had a period between 96-98 when he underachieved. He also skilled the AO until 95. Not saying he would have won every year from 89-94, but maybe he could have picked up one or 2. Who do you think could have won more majors if they maxmized their talent?
